headlines.title_en: Vietnam's Q3 economic growth at 9.95%, just one step away from full-year 10% target
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 3 — Driven by increased foreign investment and growth in factory output, Vietnam's economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter, bringing the country closer to the government's full-year double-digit growth target. Data released by Vietnam's National Statistics Office on Saturday showed that the economy grew 9.95% year-on-year in the third quarter, the fastest pace since the third quarter of 2022, higher than the median estimate of 8.65% and above the revised 8.81% in the second quarter. As one of Asia's best-performing economies, Vietnam's government set an economic growth target of at least 10% this year, hoping to upgrade its industrial chain and join the ranks of high-income countries by 2045. headlines.title: 商务部新闻发言人就对原产于欧盟的进口对硝基甲苯发起反倾销调查答记者问
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月3日讯，有记者问：我们关注到商务部今日对原产于欧盟的进口对硝基甲苯发起反倾销调查，能否介绍相关情况？答：此次调查是应国内产业申请发起的。申请人提供的初步证据显示，2022至2025年，自欧进口的对硝基甲苯产品数量处于高位，价格累计跌幅近60%，自欧倾销进口产品对中国国内产业生产经营造成了损害。根据中国法律和世贸组织规则，相关申请符合反倾销调查立案条件，中方将依法依规开展调查，充分保障各利害关系方权利，客观公正作出裁决。

headlines.title_en: Commerce Ministry spokesperson answers questions on anti-dumping probe into imports of para-nitrotoluene originating in the EU
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 3 — A reporter asked: We noticed that the Ministry of Commerce today launched an anti-dumping investigation into imports of para-nitrotoluene originating in the EU. Could you introduce the relevant situation? Answer: This investigation was initiated in response to an application from the domestic industry. The preliminary evidence provided by the applicant shows that from 2022 to 2025, the volume of para-nitrotoluene products imported from the EU remained at a high level, with prices falling by nearly 60% cumulatively, and the dumped imports from the EU caused damage to the production and operations of China's domestic industry. In accordance with Chinese law and WTO rules, the relevant application meets the conditions for filing an anti-dumping investigation. China will conduct the investigation in accordance with the law and regulations, fully protect the rights of all interested parties, and make an objective and fair ruling.

headlines.title_en: Two-year US Treasury yield rose more than 3 basis points on nonfarm payrolls day; 10-year US Treasury yield up 11 basis points this week
headlines.summary_en: Friday (October 2) at the late New York session, the U.S. 10-year benchmark Treasury yield rose 2.99 basis points to 5.2706%, plunging at 20:30 Beijing time when the nonfarm payrolls report was released, falling within one minute to 5.1528% to refresh the daily low, showing a V-shaped reversal throughout the day, and rising 11.02 basis points cumulatively this week, continuing to rise from September 28 to October 1. The two-year U.S. Treasury yield rose 3.12 basis points to 4.8247%, plunging from around 4.78% after the nonfarm payrolls data was disclosed, refreshing the daily low to 4.6913% within two minutes, then continuing to rise and refreshing the daily high to 4.8477% at 01:28, falling 2.69 basis points cumulatively this week.

headlines.title_en: French government financing costs briefly approached the 5% mark; 10-year French bond yield up about 20 basis points this week
headlines.summary_en: Friday (October 2) at the late European session, the French 10-year government bond yield fell 4.9 basis points to 4.870%, having reached 4.995% at 20:00 Beijing time (half an hour before the U.S. nonfarm payrolls report was released) — continuing to approach the third-quarter 2002 peak of 5.115% and the fourth-quarter 1996 high of 6.114%, rising 17.9 basis points cumulatively this week and continuing to rise overall. The two-year French bond yield rose 5.6 basis points to 3.738%, rising 17.1 basis points cumulatively this week; the 30-year French bond yield fell 10.7 basis points to 5.430%, rising 16.5 basis points cumulatively this week.
